labsaddons.config.title: MCLabs Addons
labsaddons.config.enabled.tooltip: Show the exclamation mark above your fishing bobber.
labsaddons.config.scale.tooltip: Size of the exclamation mark (100% = default size).
labsaddons.config.waiting_color.tooltip: Marker color while waiting for a fish.
labsaddons.config.bite_color.tooltip: Marker color while a fish is ready to be reeled in.
labsaddons.config.mute_others.tooltip: Silence cast, splash, and reel sounds from bobbers that are not yours.
labsaddons.config.catch_sound.tooltip: Sound played when a fish bites your bobber, replacing the vanilla splash. Leave as vanilla to keep the default.
labsaddons.config.item_uses.enabled.tool: Show a remaining-charges count on items like Whetstones in your inventory.
labsaddons.config.item_uses.corner.toolt: Which corner of the item slot the count is drawn in.
labsaddons.config.item_uses.scale.toolti: Size of the remaining-uses count (100% = default).
labsaddons.hud.editor.title: HUD Studio
labsaddons.hud.editor.hint: Click to select · drag to move · drag the edges to resize · arrows nudge
labsaddons.hud.editor.profiles.tooltip: Switch HUD profiles, or set which profile loads in which MCLabs world.
labsaddons.hud.profiles.title: HUD Profiles
labsaddons.hud.profiles.name: Profile name
labsaddons.hud.profiles.create.tooltip: Copies the active layout into a new profile with this name.
labsaddons.hud.profiles.rename.tooltip: Renames the active profile to this name.
labsaddons.hud.profiles.rename.default: The default profile can't be renamed — it's the fallback when no other profile loads.
labsaddons.hud.profiles.delete.tooltip: Delete this profile. Click twice to confirm.
labsaddons.hud.profiles.bind.tooltip: Which profile loads automatically when you enter %s.
labsaddons.hud.profiles.delete.confirm: Click again to delete this profile.
labsaddons.hud.chum_timer.name: Chum Timer
labsaddons.hud.editor.reset_all.tooltip: Restore this profile to its defaults — every widget's position, size and colours, plus pinned rows and hidden cooldowns. Your other profiles are untouched.
labsaddons.hud.editor.grid.tooltip: Show an alignment grid and snap to it.
labsaddons.hud.editor.snap.tooltip: Snap to edges, centre, and other widgets while dragging (hold Alt to bypass).
labsaddons.hud.editor.nudge_hint: Arrow keys move · Shift = 10px · Alt = free drag
labsaddons.hud.editor.multi_hint: %s widgets selected · drag any to move them together
